## History

Miss Rogerson is a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who taught a class for twenty years. During one service, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended her class while wearing a garland of flowers on her hat, later recounting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how miserable the experience had been.
